title: Trace
description: Contract 2 (artifact), catalog row trace 1.0.0: the replay artifact of one crushing case, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/core/trace.py to data/derived/<case>/trace.json. It holds what the Python engine computed at the case's operating point: the feed and product gradations on the engine's sieve grid, the result scalars, two one-dimensional sweeps around the point (the capacity against eccentric speed, and the product size and capacity against the closed-side setting) and the classification and appearance curves. The web replays it and holds the live TypeScript engine to it. Rules the schema cannot state, checked by the producer test: sieve_mm is strictly descending and has one more value than mid_mm; feed_passing and product_passing have the length of sieve_mm, lie in [0, 1] and do not increase along the grid; each sweep's arrays have the same length; summary equals the case manifest's metrics.

sieve_mm.description: Sieve aperture edges, coarse to fine, mm (the engine grid: 256 mm, square-root-of-two series, 29 edges).

mid_mm.description: Geometric mid-size of each size class, mm.

feed_passing.description: Feed cumulative fraction passing at each edge.

product_passing.description: Product cumulative fraction passing at each edge.

feed_mass.description: Feed mass fraction in each class (sums to 1).

product_mass.description: Product mass fraction in each class (sums to 1 within the mass-closure tolerance).

classification.description: Whiten classification function C(d) at each class mid-size: the probability a particle of that size is selected for breakage.

appearance_t10.description: The t10 of the breakage appearance function used, percent passing one tenth of the parent size.

pct_passing.description: Product fraction passing at 1, 4, 8, 16 and 32 mm.

oss_mm.description: Open-side setting, the closed-side setting plus the throw, mm.

cond_estimate.description: Conditioning proxy of (I - B C); the string Infinity when the solve is singular.

speed_sweep.description: The capacity hump: the engine at the case's point with only the eccentric speed varied over the machine's range.

css_sweep.description: The setting trade-off: the engine at the case's point with only the closed-side setting varied.
